name: Speed to lead
description: New lead gets an email and a text right away, two hours for a reply, then one more email if they went quiet and still have no call on the calendar (a lead who booked inside the two hours is left alone). A lead the engine only noticed late (GHL was down, or a minute check missed it) gets no first text or email; the team is told to follow up by hand instead. How late is too late is a setting on the first step.

nodes.subject: Got your info
nodes.template:
Hey {{contact.first_name | default:there}},

Thanks for reaching out. The easiest next step is a quick call so we can see if this is a fit. Grab a time here: {{calendar.booking.url}}

Talk soon,
{{company.name}}
Hey {{contact.first_name | default:there}}, it's {{company.name}}. Got your info, thanks. Want to grab a time to talk? {{calendar.booking.url}}
nodes.title: First-touch text

nodes.subject: Still want to talk?
nodes.template:
Hey {{contact.first_name | default:there}}, following up in case this got buried. If you still want to talk, here's the link: {{calendar.booking.url}}

If not, no worries.

nodes.title: Too late for a first text after this many minutes
Did the engine see this lead in time?
Tell the team to follow up by hand
nodes.template: <https://app.gohighlevel.com/v2/location/{{crm.location_id}}/contacts/detail/{{contact.ghl_contact_id | default:}}|{{contact.name | default:A new lead}}> came into GHL {{event.minutes_late}} minutes before the engine saw them, so no first text or email went out. Can someone follow up by hand?
